libraries.name: script
libraries.doc: The script or module instance whose code is running.

libraries.name: require
libraries.doc: Global function: runs a ModuleScript once per context and returns its value; later calls return the same value. Modules are found by instance, not by path. A cycle raises RE3004 with the chain; a module that fails or does not return exactly one value raises RE3004 on every later require. A number (an asset id) raises RE9002.

libraries.name: task
libraries.doc: Script threads: waiting, spawning, deferring and cancelling.

members.name: wait
members.doc: Suspends the thread for the given seconds (default: until the next step) and returns the time that passed. Threads resume after Heartbeat.

members.name: spawn
members.doc: Runs a function or resumes a thread now.

members.name: defer
members.doc: Runs a function at the end of the current resumption cycle.

members.name: delay
members.doc: Runs a function after the given seconds of game time.

members.name: cancel
members.doc: Cancels a thread made by task.spawn, task.defer or task.delay, or one waiting.

members.name: synchronize
members.doc: Does nothing: scripts always run serially.

members.name: desynchronize
members.doc: Does nothing: there is no parallel Luau.

libraries.name: wait
libraries.doc: Global function: task.wait with a floor of 0.03 s; returns the time waited and the game time. The first use in a context writes an RE9101 note.

libraries.name: delay
libraries.doc: Global function: task.delay. The first use in a context writes an RE9101 note.

libraries.name: spawn
libraries.doc: Global function: task.defer (the function runs later in the same cycle). The first use in a context writes an RE9101 note.

libraries.name: debug
libraries.note: profilebegin and profileend keep the label stack, but the profiler does not record script labels yet.
libraries.doc: Luau's debug library plus profiling marks.

members.name: traceback
members.doc: The current call stack as text.

members.name: info
members.doc: Facts about a function or stack level.

members.name: profilebegin
members.note: The label is kept but not recorded by the profiler yet.
